import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] A = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static int n, t;
    static boolean[][][][][] vis = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reach = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
    static List<List<Integer>> adj;
    static int[][] cap = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] flow = new int[210][210];
    static int[] excess = new int[210];
    static int[] height = new int[210];
    static int[][] nodeMap = new int[11][11];

    static void propagate(int time, int x, int y, int sx, int sy) {
        if (t >= 70) return;
        if (x < 0 || x >= n || y < 0 || y >= n) return;
        if (A[x][y] < '0' || A[x][y] > '9') return;
        if (time > t + 1) return;
        if (vis[time][x][y][sx][sy]) return;
        if (time > dist[x][y] && dist[x][y] != 0) return;
        if (time == dist[x][y] && dist[x][y] != 0 && (B[x][y] > '9' || B[x][y] <= '0')) return;
        vis[time][x][y][sx][sy] = true;
        if (time < dist[x][y]) {
            propagate(time + 1, x, y, sx, sy);
            propagate(time + 1, x + 1, y, sx, sy);
            propagate(time + 1, x - 1, y, sx, sy);
            propagate(time + 1, x, y + 1, sx, sy);
            propagate(time + 1, x, y - 1, sx, sy);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                A[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                B[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);

        Deque<int[]> bfsQ = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; ++j)
                dist[i][j] = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    bfsQ.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!bfsQ.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfsQ.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            if (dist[x][y] >= t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                        A[nx][ny] >= '0' && A[nx][ny] <= '9' && dist[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    bfsQ.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (A[i][j] >= '0' && A[i][j] <= '9')
                    propagate(0, i, j, i, j);

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; ++i1)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; ++j1)
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; ++i2)
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; ++j2)
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; ++nt)
                            if (vis[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2])
                                reach[i1][j1][i2][j2] = true;

        adj = new ArrayList<>();
        adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; ++i1)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; ++j1)
                if (A[i1][j1] > '0' && A[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int u = adj.size();
                    adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    excess[u] = A[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; ++i2)
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; ++j2)
                            if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9' && reach[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                int v;
                                if (nodeMap[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                    nodeMap[i2][j2] = adj.size();
                                    adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                }
                                v = nodeMap[i2][j2];
                                adj.get(u).add(v);
                                adj.get(v).add(u);
                                cap[u][v] = 10000;
                                cap[v][u] = 0;
                            }
                }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; ++i2)
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; ++j2)
                if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9' && nodeMap[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int v = nodeMap[i2][j2];
                    adj.get(v).add(0);
                    cap[v][0] = B[i2][j2] - '0';
                    cap[0][v] = 0;
                }

        for (int i = 0; i < adj.size(); ++i) height[i] = 0;
        height[0] = adj.size();

        while (true) {
            boolean changed = false;
            for (int u = 1; u < adj.size(); ++u) {
                while (excess[u] > 0) {
                    boolean pushed = false;
                    int minHeight = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v : adj.get(u)) {
                        if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) minHeight = Math.min(minHeight, height[v]);
                        if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                            int delta = Math.min(cap[u][v] - flow[u][v], excess[u]);
                            flow[u][v] += delta;
                            flow[v][u] -= delta;
                            excess[u] -= delta;
                            excess[v] += delta;
                            pushed = true;
                            changed = true;
                            if (excess[u] == 0) break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (height[u] != minHeight + 1 && minHeight != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        height[u] = minHeight + 1;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                    if (!pushed) break;
                }
            }
            if (!changed) break;
        }

        System.out.println(excess[0]);
    }
}
